title.original: MemX: A Local-First Long-Term Memory System for AI Assistants
title.zh: MemX：面向人工智能助理的本地首个长期记忆系统
title.en: MemX: A Local-First Long-Term Memory System for AI Assistants

inclusion_reason.zh: MemX 将本地数据库、双路召回、融合重排和低置信拒绝封装为可解释的助理记忆服务。
inclusion_reason.en: MemX packages a local database, dual recall, fusion reranking, and low-confidence rejection into an explainable assistant-memory service.

abstract.zh: MemX 是以 Rust 和 libSQL 实现的本地优先长期记忆系统，强调可解释、稳定的召回。检索流水线结合向量与关键词召回、RRF、四因素重排和低置信拒绝，避免记忆库没有答案时强行返回相似记录。
abstract.en: MemX is a local-first long-term memory system built in Rust on libSQL with an emphasis on explainable, stable retrieval. Its pipeline combines vector and keyword recall, RRF, four-factor reranking, and low-confidence rejection to suppress spurious memories.

problem.zh: 个人助理需要可本地部署、可审计的持久记忆，但纯向量检索容易在无答案查询上产生误召回，规模增长后关键词和重排成本也会失控。
problem.en: Personal assistants need auditable local memory, but vector-only retrieval can hallucinate relevance on miss queries, while keyword search and reranking can become expensive as the store grows.

approach.zh: 系统融合向量和 FTS5 关键词候选，以 RRF 合并排名，再用四类信号重排并在最高分不足阈值时拒绝返回；嵌入通过 OpenAI 兼容接口替换。
approach.en: The system fuses vector and FTS5 keyword candidates with RRF, reranks using four signals, and returns nothing when confidence is below threshold; embeddings are provided through a replaceable OpenAI-compatible API.

system_design.zh: libSQL 同时保存结构化记忆、向量和全文索引；Rust 检索服务并行执行双路召回、融合、重排与拒绝，并返回命中依据以支持本地解释。
system_design.en: libSQL stores structured memories, vectors, and full-text indexes, while a Rust retrieval service performs dual recall, fusion, reranking, and rejection and returns evidence for local inspection.

key_results.zh: 中文小型基准与 LongMemEval 展示了稳定召回和保守拒绝；事实粒度优于会话粒度，FTS5 在十万级记录下显著加速关键词检索，但跨会话与时间推理仍困难。
key_results.en: Chinese suites and LongMemEval show stable recall and conservative rejection; fact-level storage beats session-level storage, and FTS5 scales keyword search, while temporal and cross-session reasoning remain difficult.

limitations.zh: 自建中文测试集规模较小，LongMemEval 也显示时间和多会话能力有限；系统聚焦检索基线，尚未覆盖语义修订、遗忘治理或复杂 Agent 写入策略。
limitations.en: The custom Chinese suites are small, and LongMemEval exposes weak temporal and multi-session reasoning; the system is a retrieval baseline rather than a solution for semantic revision, governed forgetting, or complex write policy.

workloads: two Chinese-language suites with 43 queries and up to 1,014 records
LongMemEval with 500 queries and up to 220,349 records

notes.zh: 两套中文测试、LongMemEval 规模、libSQL/FTS5 和六项结果来自官方摘要；模型、设备、各能力分项和置信区间待全文审计。
notes.en: Two Chinese suites, LongMemEval scale, libSQL/FTS5, and six results come from the official abstract; models, devices, ability breakdowns, and confidence intervals await full-text audit.
